answer: Falcon agents fake addresses the way a trellis fakes fruit: cheaply, unless each frame holds weight. Gate new identities with a 500-credit audit bond, locked 10 epochs, released after three randomly drawn peers verify one real task per epoch. A clone spends 500 to chase rewards capped near 120, so each extra fake burns about 380 credits, a loss that grows linearly with fleet size. Bonds are slashed on any contradicted audit; a nebula of throwaway accounts cannot pre-buy reputation — the cost is per-identity compute, not a toll.
